- Some apps can now be marked experimental in the picker, with a note saying
  what is wrong. Google Setup Wizard is the first: it crash-loops first boot on
  some devices, so if setup hangs, skip it and sign in from Settings instead
- Added an opt-in factory reset protection wipe to the recovery installer:
  `-wipe-frp` on the command line, or the box in the app's expert mode. Off by
  default
- The picker's presets and experimental warnings now come with the app and can
  be corrected without waiting for a new package dump
- The Android app carries the size of an update it offers
- Internal: the package manifest no longer rejects a file written by a newer
  version of the tool, so older builds keep working as the format grows
